    }

    function hideError(viewId) {
        var el = document.getElementById(viewId);
        if (el) { el.style.display = 'none'; }
    }

    // Move single captcha container to the active view
    function moveCaptchaToView(targetContainerId) {

        moveCaptchaToView('authRegCaptchaContainer');

    function switchToLogin() {

        document.getElementById('authLoginView').style.display = 'block';
        hideError('authRegError');
        hideError('authLoginError');
        moveCaptchaToView('authLoginCaptchaContainer');
        resetCaptcha();

    function loadCaptcha() {

        if (localCaptchaToken) {

            renderCaptcha();

        }
        var script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = 'https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js?onload=onUnifiedAuthCaptchaLoad&render=explicit';

        window.onUnifiedAuthCaptchaLoad = function() {
            renderCaptcha();

        document.head.appendChild(script);
    }

    function renderCaptcha() {
        var el = document.getElementById('authCaptchaWidget');
        if (!el || !recaptchaSiteKey || captchaLoaded) return;

            captchaWidgetId = grecaptcha.render(el, {
                sitekey: recaptchaSiteKey,
                size: 'normal'
            });
            captchaLoaded = true;
        } catch(e) {
            if (console && console.warn) console.warn('reCAPTCHA render:', e);
            captchaLoaded = true;

        if (captchaWidgetId !== null && typeof grecaptcha !== 'undefined') {

            '&termsSha256=' + encodeURIComponent(currentTermsSha256);

    function doRegister() {
        if (isRegistering) return;
        var email = document.getElementById('authRegEmail').value.trim();
        var emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

        if (!captcha) {
            showError('authRegError', 'Please complete the captcha');

        isRegistering = true;

        var body = JSON.stringify({

                if (!resp.ok) throw data;
                return data;
            });
        }).then(function() {

    function doLogin() {
        if (isLoggingIn) return;
        var email = document.getElementById('authLoginEmail').value.trim();
        var password = document.getElementById('authLoginPassword').value;
        if (!email) {
            showError('authLoginError', 'Please enter your email or username');
            return;
        }
        if (!password) {
            showError('authLoginError', 'Please enter your password');
            return;
        }
        var captcha = getCaptchaResponse();
        if (!captcha) {
            showError('authLoginError', 'Please complete the captcha');
            return;
        }
        isLoggingIn = true;
        hideError('authLoginError');
        document.getElementById('authLoginSubmit').textContent = 'Logging in...';

            method: 'POST',
            headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},

        }).then(function(resp) {

                return data;
            });

            var target = currentRedirect || window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
            var currentBase = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
            window.location.href = target;
            if (target.split('#')[0] === currentBase || target === window.location.href) {
                window.location.reload();

            isLoggingIn = false;
            document.getElementById('authLoginSubmit').textContent = 'Log In';

    document.getElementById('authSwitchToLogin').addEventListener('click', switchToLogin);
    document.getElementById('authSwitchToRegister').addEventListener('click', switchToRegister);
    document.getElementById('authRegSubmit').addEventListener('click', doRegister);
    document.getElementById('authLoginSubmit').addEventListener('click', doLogin);
    document.getElementById('authGoogleRegister').addEventListener('click', continueWithGoogle);

        if (!unifiedRemodalInstance && loginShell) {
            unifiedRemodalInstance = $(loginShell).remodal();
        }

        if (unifiedRemodalInstance) {
            unifiedRemodalInstance.open();
        }

        // Load captcha after modal is visible
        setTimeout(function() {
            loadCaptcha();
        }, 300);
    };
